observations: Deposit #1121 (Pearl and Other Poems) was read in pass 2 from two attachments, the PDF text (derived/attachments/AXN-0472/pearl-and-other-poems-2014.pdf.txt) and the machine text (alexanarch AXN-0472/pearl-and-other-poems-machine-text.txt), so several finds are one passage twice: F1121.B1 = F1121.B4 (Sigil's 'destined to stick around'), F1121.B2 = F1121.B6 ('Make It Human'), F1121.E3 = F1121.E8 (the '21st Century Literary History' chart), F1121.H2 = F1121.H4 (forum post 7/27/14). F1121.H1 and F1121.H3 are two passages of one essay, LITTACHUR. Each was decided 'new' or 'related' on its own, because pass-2 finds are not claims a decision can name; the assembly should join each pair as one claim.

F1121.E7 (Pearl, 'Premonition Dream') is dated 27 April, 2014 in the book, and #973 (PRED-973.E1) dates the same poem 27 April, 2013 (#973 lines 8, 43; machine text lines 2603, 2678). Recorded as a variant with a moved window, not as an error.

F1121.E9 ('Backlash': 'humanity has no new madnesses to contend with due to the inability of Tiger Leap to locate a capable publisher') is the same book's in-fiction playback of the F1121.E5 dedication forecast as unfulfilled; a later pass may attach it to F1121.E5's claim as a fictional confirmation record.
F1409.A1 to A4 (H1 to H4 of EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01) and F1409.F1/F2 belong with PRED-1407.A1's H5-ACT as one pre-registered study; the H5 statement of #1409 itself was not in this batch.
